info.title: Lab Tickets - contract only
info.description: Illustrative lab API contract. No deployed backend, authentication, or real tickets. Not connected to the draft topic. Never use with production or personal data.

post.description: Contract only. A future lab backend must validate the input and confirmation. No backend is provided.

201.description: A fictional lab ticket was persisted by a future backend; never returned by this repository.

400.description: Invalid summary, category, or missing explicit confirmation.

503.description: Lab backend unavailable; creation is not confirmed.

summary.description: Invented symptom only; no secrets or personal data. Backend must also reject whitespace-only text.

confirmed.description: Explicit confirmation of these exact details. A field is not proof of user consent or authorization.

ticketId.description: Identifier returned by a future backend, never generated by the agent.

message.description: Safe lab error without secrets or raw internal diagnostics.
